title: What Happens When Maths Goes Wrong? - with Matt Parker
summary: Matt Parker's Royal Institution talk based on his book Humble Pi, covering everyday mathematical mistakes and spurious patterns that went wrong in engineering and software. It mixes stand-up comedy with stories of coincidence and error.
why: Used as a funny, accessible reference for coincidences, spurious patterns and maths errors.

quote.text: It also comes with an entirely different set of interesting stories for anyone inclined to listen
